# E0151: a collection's lineage has no normalized.gen.cue, or one that is not the normal form of its history/

A lineage of a collection keeps its normal form, its history/ compiled, in
normalized.gen.cue beside its tip, where native CUE imports it. The file is
generated, and is checked to be what history/ compiles to. Here ship has cut
0.1 without regenerating it, so it holds only 0.0, and boat's was edited by
hand. The same code reports a lineage with no normalized.gen.cue at all.

## Example

`lineages/boat/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`lineages/boat/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`lineages/boat/normalized.gen.cue`:

```cue
// Code generated by thema from this lineage's history/. DO NOT EDIT.
//
// This is the lineage's normal form: every version under history/, compiled,
// and never the tip. Regenerate it with thema lineage compile.
package boat

import (
	"github.com/sdboyer/thema"
)

thema.Lineage

name: "boat"

schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				name: "edited"
			}
		}
	}
}

lenses: {}
```

`lineages/ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

`lineages/ship/history/0.1.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name:   string
	crew?: int
}
```

`lineages/ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name:   string
	crew?: int
}
```

`lineages/ship/normalized.gen.cue`:

```cue
// Code generated by thema from this lineage's history/. DO NOT EDIT.
//
// This is the lineage's normal form: every version under history/, compiled,
// and never the tip. Regenerate it with thema lineage compile.
package ship

import (
	"github.com/sdboyer/thema"
)

thema.Lineage

name: "ship"

schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				name: string
			}
		}
	}
}

lenses: {}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0151]: normalized.gen.cue is not the normal form of boat's history/
  --> lineages/boat/normalized.gen.cue:19:1
   |
19 |                 name: "edited"
   | ^
   |
   = note: line 19 is `name: "edited"`; generated from history/, it is `name: string`
   = note: normalized.gen.cue is generated: an edit to it, or a change to history/ without regenerating it, makes it disagree with what thema binds
   = help: regenerate it with thema lineage compile -l <the lineage's directory, or its collection's>

error[E0151]: normalized.gen.cue is not the normal form of ship's history/
 --> lineages/ship/normalized.gen.cue:1:1
  |
1 | // Code generated by thema from this lineage's history/. DO NOT EDIT.
  | ^
  |
  = note: it holds versions 0.0, and history/ holds 0.0, 0.1
  = note: normalized.gen.cue is generated: an edit to it, or a change to history/ without regenerating it, makes it disagree with what thema binds
  = help: regenerate it with thema lineage compile -l <the lineage's directory, or its collection's>
```
